data.name: Abisha
data.gender_notes: Abisha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Servant of Allah (Abu) + Sha (Allah's Grace). The name Abisha carries the meaning “Servant of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Abisha usually hope their child will grow to embody servant of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name for a girl who is devoted to Allah and believes in His divine grace
data.etymology: Abisha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Servant of Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Abisha total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: ابيشة
in_arabic.meaning: إسم يعني باللغة العربية الحياة السعيدة والمرضية لله تعالى
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم ابيشة هو اسم علم مؤنث من أصل عربي، ويعني الحياة السعيدة والمرضية لله تعالى. وقد ورد في بعض المصادر أنه مشتق من كلمة 'ابيش' التي تعني الهناء والسعادة. ويعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني جميلة ومرضية لله تعالى، مما يجعله من الأسماء المحببة لدى المسلمين.

in_urdu.name: ابیشہ
in_urdu.meaning: سعید زندگی اور اللہ تعالی کی رضا
in_urdu.long_meaning: ابیشہ ایک علم مؤنث نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب سعید زندگی اور اللہ تعالی کی رضا سے ہے۔ بعض مصادر کے مطابق یہ 'ابيش' سے مشتق ہے جس کا مطلب ہے خوشحالی اور سعادت۔ یہ نام مسلمانوں کے درمیان مقبول ہے کیونکہ اس کے معنی اچھے اور اللہ تعالی کو منافع ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: अबीशा
in_hindi.meaning: सुखी जीवन और ईश्वर की कृपा
in_hindi.long_meaning: अबीशा एक स्त्रीलिंग नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है। इसका अर्थ सुखी जीवन और ईश्वर की कृपा है। कुछ स्रोतों के अनुसार यह 'अबिश' से व्युत्पन्न है जिसका अर्थ है सुख और समृद्धि। यह नाम मुसलमानों के बीच लोकप्रिय है क्योंकि इसके अर्थ अच्छे और ईश्वर को प्रिय हैं।

in_pashto.name: ابېشې
in_pashto.meaning: سعادتمند ژوند او د الله رضا
in_pashto.long_meaning: ابېشې يو علم مؤنث نوم دے چې د عربي ژبې څخه اخيستل شوی دے. دغه نوم د سعادتمند ژوند او د الله رضا معنی لري. د ځينو سرچينو په وینا دا 'ابيش' څخه مشتق شوی دے چې د خوشحالۍ او سعادت معنی لري. دا نوم د مسلمانانو تر منځ مشهور دے ځکه چې د معنی يې ښې او د الله تعالی لپاره ګران دي.

in_english.name: Abisha
in_english.meaning: Happy life and pleasing to God
in_english.long_meaning: Abisha is a feminine given name of Arabic origin. It means 'happy life' and 'pleasing to God'. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'abish' which signifies 'happiness' and 'bliss'. This name holds significant spiritual connotations, reflecting a life that is not only joyful but also righteous and pleasing to Allah. Historically, names like Abisha have been used in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing the aspiration for a life that balances worldly happiness with spiritual fulfillment.

This name holds significant importance within the Islamic community, highlighting one's dedication to Allah and the belief that His blessings are a constant presence in one's life.
data.spiritual_significance: The name "Abisha" carries a profound spiritual significance as it underscores the fundamental Islamic belief in devotion to Allah and trusting in His Divine Will and Grace. The given name serves as a daily reminder for individuals to abide by Allah's commandments and seek His blessings in all aspects of life, fostering a strong moral and spiritual foundation.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Servant of Allah" symbolizes Servant of Allah (Abu) + Sha (Allah's Grace). In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Abisha serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of servant of allah.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Abisha bint Abd al-Muttalib (d. 652 AD) was the sister of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh). She is mentioned in various hadiths and is considered a role model for Muslim women.

trends: Abisha is a popular name among Muslims, especially in the Middle East and South Asia.
modern_usage.modern_context: The name Abisha remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.

name_in_real_life.story: A successful entrepreneur named Layla Abisha in Cairo, Egypt attributes much of their success to the blessing of their name Abisha, which means "Servant of Allah". They believe their name has shaped their identity and guided them through life.
